prompt_metadata.app_name: DocReader - Professional Multi-Format Office Suite & Annotator
prompt_metadata.tagline: Open, annotate, and navigate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint with desktop-grade fidelity.
prompt_metadata.architecture_pattern: MVVM + Clean Architecture + MVI for Document States
prompt_metadata.monetization: Hybrid: Free (View up to 10 documents/mo, basic search, standard rendering + AdMob Ads) | Premium Pro ($3.99/mo subscription or $19.99 lifetime purchase to unlock unlimited documents, vector-ink annotations, PDF export/signatures, cloud storage integration, and an ad-free workstation)

agent_instructions.role: You are a Principal Mobile Software Architect and Document Systems Engineer. Your goal is to design 'DocReader', a highly optimized, low-latency document viewer that parses complex Microsoft Office formats (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx), legacy types, and RTF, converting raw binary hierarchies into high-performance, scrollable Compose interfaces with precise rendering fidelity.
agent_instructions.design_philosophy: Zero-latency executive workstation. Document loading and text layout calculations must run entirely on background worker threads, presenting a highly responsive, stutter-free viewport. The UI must feel administrative, distraction-free, and clean, featuring dedicated paper-view, sepia, and dark-reading modes.
code_standards: Strict separation of concerns using Clean Architecture: Presentation (Compose UI, ViewModels, MVI Intents), Domain (Document Parsers, Annotation UseCases, Document Security), Data (Apache POI wrappers, Room DB, SAF content providers).
Dynamic MVI state machines using Kotlin StateFlows to transition smoothly between document loading, parsing, page rendering, editing annotations, and exporting.
Extreme memory optimization: Implement streaming SAX parsers (such as Apache POI's XSSFReader) for large spreadsheets to prevent JVM OutOfMemory (OOM) errors on low-end devices.
Absolute local persistence of annotations and reading history stored in Room, securely linked using SHA-256 file checksums so annotations survive file-relocations.

multi_format_document_engine.description: High-fidelity, local-first parser converting proprietary office structures into readable layout models.
multi_format_document_engine.word_processing_parser: Parse XML-based DOCX elements (paragraphs, tables, inline run stylings, hyperlinked text) via Apache POI. Construct a linear paginated flow mapping custom Compose Texts and interactive rich text styles.
multi_format_document_engine.spreadsheet_grid_builder: Process multi-sheet workbook files (.xlsx, .xls). Map row-and-column arrays dynamically onto a custom 2D scrollable Compose Canvas. Support cell style formats, active column-resizing, and dynamic cell-freeze parameters.
multi_format_document_engine.slideshow_paginator: Extract PowerPoint (.pptx) layouts, text frames, shapes, and images. Present them in an interactive slide-carousel with precise scale-to-fit parameters.

vector_annotation_subsystem.description: An overlay layer allowing users to write, highlight, and attach comments directly on active documents.
vector_annotation_subsystem.canvas_freehand_ink: Implement a touch-driven vector drawing layer on Compose Canvas using Beziér path smoothing. Save drawing coordinates as normalized float-point maps.
vector_annotation_subsystem.highlight_and_comment: Support selection coordinates to apply highlighted background states. Users can anchor text comments onto specific coordinate frames of the parsed document.
vector_annotation_subsystem.integrity_preservation: Calculate file SHA-256 hashes upon ingestion. Store annotation vector paths, selected text bounds, and comment text alongside the hash in Room, guaranteeing matching alignments upon subsequent opens.

saf_workspace_manager.description: A fluid document explorer and workspace organizer integrating native Scoped Storage protocols.
saf_workspace_manager.saf_integration: Seamless integration with Android's Storage Access Framework (SAF). Allow users to fetch files from secondary SD cards or cloud providers via standard document-provider URI authorities.
saf_workspace_manager.recents_and_bookmarks: An organized file shelf displaying recent files with file size, format badges, and exact page progress. Enable users to bookmark specific chapters or sheets.

admob_monetization_layer.banner_ads: Collapsible smart banners integrated at the base of the Document Explorer and Settings screens (permanently hidden in Pro-tier).
admob_monetization_layer.interstitial_ads: Gracefully loaded immediately after closing a document or saving an annotation set (capped with a strict 15-minute cooldown timer to protect the enterprise reading flow).
admob_monetization_layer.rewarded_ads: Watch an ad to unlock high-fidelity rendering of documents over 10MB or to export a paginated document to PDF for free.

core_mechanics.consent_platform: Integrate the Google User Messaging Platform (UMP) SDK to capture compliant GDPR and international privacy consent before initializing any AdMob assets.

key_permissions: android.permission.INTERNET (Required for Google Play Billing, cloud parsing, and AdMob services)
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS (For WorkManager document-to-PDF conversion status notifications)
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC (Required for background document-to-PDF rendering pipelines on Android 14+)

module_architecture.app: Application initialization, Hilt module bindings, entry-point route setups.
module_architecture.core_ui: Professional executive tokens (Executive Blue, Steel Slate, Light Paper background), custom double-ended zoom sliders, custom paginated canvas viewers, and spring transitions.
module_architecture.feature_explorer: Storage Access Framework hooks, recent files shelf, category filters, metadata indexers.
module_architecture.feature_reader: Apache POI integrations, thread-isolated text paginators, custom Excel sheet tables, and PPT slide swipe carousels.
module_architecture.feature_annotations: Vector ink Canvas systems, touch gesture tracking, annotation overlay managers, and room backup controllers.
module_architecture.feature_pro: Google Play Billing client binders, premium entitlement verification hooks, Pro Paywall screens.

document_state_machine.state_model: data class DocReaderState(val activeDocumentUri: Uri?, val isLoading: Boolean, val documentHash: String?, val currentPage: Int, val totalPages: Int, val activeAnnotations: List, val selectedUiTheme: ReaderTheme, val isPro: Boolean)
document_state_machine.reader_theme: enum class ReaderTheme { DAY_PAPER, SEPIA_WARM, NIGHT_DARK, SYSTEM_DEFAULT }

core_dependencies.database_orm: androidx.room:room-runtime:2.6.x & room-compiler (using room-ktx for tracking history and annotations)

theme_color_palette.secondary: #0D9488 (Comforting Forest Teal - used for active annotations and highlights)

ui_ux_design.design_notes: Sleek sepia and night alternatives are dynamic. Touch-targets must maintain a 48dp minimum for all annotations, margins must represent real page layouts, and scroll feedback must feature micro-dampening animations.

execution_roadmap.description: Establish multi-module structure utilizing Clean Architecture guidelines. Configure Hilt containers, set up Kotlin Version Catalogs, prepare Type-Safe Compose Navigation routes, and initialize Room databases for file-access registries.

Integrate SAF DocumentProvider interfaces. Implement metadata readers compiling document formats, byte size boundaries, and file dates. Build dynamic explorer feeds featuring categorized tabs (All, Word, Excel, Slide, Text).

execution_roadmap.phase_3: The Apache POI Document Parsing Engine
execution_roadmap.description: Configure Apache POI memory-optimized libraries on Android background threads. Build parsers rendering word paragraphs, extracting Excel cells dynamically into 2D tables, and mapping slide runs into individual carousel containers.
Build high-performance paginated structures inside Jetpack Compose UI. Manage text alignments, column sizing rules, zoom-and-pan gestures, and scrolling thresholds.

Build interactive Canvas structures allowing vector path drawing and highlighters. Map annotations onto document-level coordinate bounds. Integrate file SHA-256 check controllers to persist markup models securely in Room.

Initialize the Google User Messaging Platform (UMP) SDK. Construct modular Compose container overlays to request location/privacy consent loops before initializing the AdMob SDK. Inject responsive Anchor adaptive Banners and custom-capped Interstitial triggers.

Build the Google Play Billing subscription repository. Construct a modern, visually striking Pro Paywall featuring dynamic cards, comparison grids, and spring transition animations that bypasses AdMob overlays upon transaction validation.

Measure and optimize layout calculations for complex structures. Schedule background WorkManager tasks converting parsed models into structured PDF print-jobs using PDFDocument components. Build and generate the final signed release artifact.
